title: Sun-angle 3D reconstruction of the FLIR1 object
summary: Merrick tells of Sun-angle 3D reconstruction of the FLIR1 object, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we can actually find which direction Underwood was flying and we can see where the sun was at around 330 320ish give or take

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, a Navy jet's heat-sensing camera filmed a strange object, and that video is known as FLIR1. A researcher named Merrick, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says his group can work out which way the pilot, Chad Underwood, was flying and where the sun sat in the sky, at a heading of roughly 320 to 330 degrees. He says this lets them rebuild the object's shape in three dimensions, which could help settle what was really in the video.
